item.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
item.description: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
item.description: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
item.description: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
item.description: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
item.description: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
item.description: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned EU lawmakers that delays in finalizing digital euro legislation could push back its potential 2029 rollout.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Stock ETF buyers pounce on dip as Bitcoin funds bleed $1.6 billion
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have lost $1.6 billion in November, while stock funds attracted billions of dollars from investors buying the dip.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: SEC enforcement actions fall 24%, crypto cases in spotlight
item.description: The SEC filed 348 actions in fiscal 2026, down from 456 a year earlier. Cases included alleged Bitcoin mining fraud and an FTX audit settlement.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
item.description: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
item.description: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
item.description: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
item.description: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
item.description: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
item.description: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
item.description: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
item.description: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
item.description: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

media:content.caption: avalanche token in front of the NYSE
media:content.media:description: avalanche token in front of the NYSE

item.title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
item.description: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
item.description: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
item.description: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
item.description: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
item.description: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
item.description: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
item.description: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
item.description: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
item.description: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
item.description: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing
item.description: Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Bryan O'Shea

item.title: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech
item.description: Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
